# Configure Workers Builds (`configure_workers_builds`)

MCP tool `repository_cloudflare_configureBuilds` · scope `access_provider_connections` · destructive

Configures production and Previews Base Builds settings for an attached Worker, GitHub repository,
and root directory, then starts a production build. It can overwrite the Worker's existing Builds
settings. New connections enable native Worker Previews. Existing connections must already use
native Worker Previews. A connection to a different repository is never adopted. Samebase reads the
current Worker and repository state live and stores no build-settings or status mirror in Convex. It
does not revoke or rotate Convex deploy keys.

## Arguments

- `repository` (string, required): The repository as GitHub owner/name, or its repositoryId from
  repository_list.
- `workerName` (string, required): Name of the attached Worker.
- `rootDirectory` (string, optional): Optional root directory. It must equal the Worker's recorded
  root directory, which is the default.
- `buildTokenUuid` (string, optional): Optional Workers Builds token UUID. Omit it: Samebase uses
  the last-used token, else the only token, and lists the tokens when it needs the user's choice.

## Returns

The reply is confirmation text only; the tool sets no `structuredContent`.
